quote: The table-based QA task is defined as the problem of generating an answer a to a question q based on a table T with metadata m using a model M which can be formulated as a = M(T, m, q). In our dataset, The format of answers a is free-form natural language.
We evaluate LLMs (e.g., GPT-4) with different prompting methods on CRT-QA.
outputs: free-form natural language answers to table-based questions
